structures.label: Right lobe
structures.function: Largest anatomical lobe of the liver.

structures.label: Left lobe
structures.function: Anatomical lobe extending toward the left upper abdomen.

structures.label: Caudate lobe
structures.function: Small anatomical lobe on the posterior visceral surface.

structures.label: Quadrate lobe
structures.function: Anatomical lobe on the inferior surface.

structures.label: Falciform ligament
structures.function: Peritoneal fold associated with the anatomical division between right and left lobes on the diaphragmatic surface.

structures.label: Gallbladder
structures.function: Stores and concentrates bile produced by the liver.

structures.label: Porta hepatis
structures.function: Transverse gateway on the visceral surface for major vessels, ducts, nerves, and lymphatics.

structures.label: Hepatic portal vein
structures.function: Delivers nutrient-rich venous blood from abdominal digestive organs to the liver.

structures.label: Proper hepatic artery
structures.function: Supplies oxygenated arterial blood to the liver.

structures.label: Common hepatic duct
structures.function: Carries bile away from the liver's right and left hepatic ducts.

structures.label: Hepatic veins
aliases: right middle and left hepatic veins
structures.function: Drain venous blood from the liver toward the inferior vena cava.

structures.label: Inferior vena cava
structures.function: Receives hepatic venous drainage on the posterior aspect of the liver.
